name: ASSA ABLOY AB (publ)
summary: ASSA ABLOY AB (publ) provides door opening and access products for the institutional, commercial, and residential markets. It operates through Europe, the Middle East, India, and Africa (EMEIA); North and South America (Americas); Asia and Oceania (Asia Pacific); Global Technologies; and Entrance Systems divisions.
